prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1276; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client regarding injuries sustained in a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. Our client was driving lawfully when the other driver moved into the lane and made contact with the side of the client's vehicle. Our client has since sought medical treatment for injuries that are still being evaluated, and the full impact on work and daily life is continuing to develop.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. If you need to speak with our client about any aspect of the claim, we ask that you first arrange that through our firm.

We also request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage, so that we can assess the claim properly.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, recorded statements, claim notes, telematics or dashcam data, repair estimates, and any vehicle or property involved in the collision. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or otherwise lost while the claim is open.
